description: Java source code for RmTypeDefs class, which finds and deletes typedef annotation classes in Android projects, using ASM bytecode manipulation.

classes.name: RmTypeDefs
classes.description: Main class that handles finding and removing typedef annotation classes in Android projects.

classes.name: TypeDefVisitor
classes.description: Inner class extending ClassVisitor to identify typedef annotation classes during bytecode analysis.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initiates the process based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Processes command-line arguments, scans directories, and manages the deletion process.

methods.name: checkFile
methods.description: Recursively scans directories for .class files to analyze.

methods.name: checkClass
methods.description: Reads a .class file and uses ASM to analyze if it is a typedef annotation.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the tool.

methods.name: addTypeDef
methods.description: Records a class as a typedef annotation and its associated file.

methods.name: rewriteOuterClasses
methods.description: Rewrites outer class files to remove references to typedef inner classes.

methods.name: deleteAnnotationClasses
methods.description: Deletes the identified typedef annotation class files.
